create.name: Sivananda Yoga Vedanta Center Ho Chi Minh City
create.bio:
Sivananda Yoga's Ho Chi Minh City centre is one of three city centres of the International Sivananda Yoga Vedanta Centres in Vietnam, alongside a centre in Da Lat and the organisation's residential ashram and training centre beside Tuyền Lâm Lake outside Da Lat. Sivananda yoga reached Vietnam in 2010, when Swami Sitaramananda, a direct disciple of Swami Vishnudevananda, began bringing the international teacher training course to the country. The Ho Chi Minh City centre occupies a roomy building in Phú Nhuận District, with an indoor hall and a leafy outdoor deck for practice.

The centre teaches classical hatha yoga through Vishnudevananda's five points of exercise, breathing, relaxation, diet, and positive thinking with meditation. Open classes run every day and can be taken singly or with weekly and monthly passes, and a structured beginners' course lays the foundations. A first trial class is free, and the community meets on Wednesdays and Sundays for satsang with meditation, kirtan and a reading on yoga philosophy, also without charge. The centre is a meeting place for graduates of the Sivananda teacher training, who help run it as karma yoga. Students who want to teach go on to the four-week residential training and the advanced course at the Da Lat ashram.

courses.title: Open yoga classes in Ho Chi Minh City
courses.description: Daily classical Sivananda classes at the Phú Nhuận centre, open to all levels, with drop-in visits or weekly and monthly passes. The centre also runs a beginners' course on the five points of yoga.

courses.title: Yoga Teacher Training Course in Vietnam
courses.description: The organisation's 28-day residential teacher training at its ashram near Tuyền Lâm Lake outside Da Lat, leading to the Sivananda certificate at the 200-hour standard. Days combine meditation, two asana classes, lectures on philosophy and anatomy, chanting and karma yoga. Several intakes a year; the fee includes room and meals.

courses.title: Advanced Yoga Teacher Training Course (ATTC)
courses.description: A four-week residential follow-on for graduates of the teacher training, with Vedanta and the Yoga Sutras, advanced asana and pranayama, karma and bhakti yoga, and an introduction to Sanskrit, held at the Da Lat ashram.

free_resources.title: Community Satsang
free_resources.description: Free gatherings at the centre every Wednesday and Sunday with silent meditation, kirtan and a reading or talk on yoga philosophy. A free trial class is also offered to newcomers.
